challenge.method: Tested GPL-2.0-only and a GPL-3.0-or-later minimum against the exact version clause. Also checked whether the SPDX exception record could independently select a base or extend the permission to the skeleton itself.
challenge.results: The express later-version option defeats the version-2-only reading. The express availability of version 2 defeats a version-3 minimum. The exception grants use of the resulting output under its copying condition. SPDX repeats that grant and contains no base-version declaration.

limitations: The finding describes this object's header and conditional permission. Project-wide licensing, application to a particular generated program and the licensing of other files require separate evidence.
Official release-archive provenance remains unresolved. The SPDX entry alone leaves the base version undetermined.
reasoning: The skeleton header permits redistribution or modification under the GNU General Public License as published by the Free Software Foundation, “either version 2, or (at your option) any later version.” This supports GPL-2.0-or-later as the documented base. The immediately following comment grants the output-use permission and attributes its introduction to Bison 1.24. The base and exception are thus evidenced together in the same object.
